steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX functionality required by the test company.
Allow the buyer to add the QA vendor during event creation.

Give the event the mandatory title needed for publishing and later vendor navigation.
Apply the first available questionnaire template.

Complete mandatory buyer-side questionnaire configuration for the RFP.
Assign the evaluator required for an RFP to publish.

args.goal: On the buyer's single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set the first clause to Required and the second clause to None, click Done, and stop with the configured Terms & Conditions visible.

steps.note: Configure the two event clauses; no catalog domain step directly edits Terms & Conditions.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Commit the 30-minute schedule requested by the case.
Publish the configured RFP.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open this event's RFP questionnaire and terms as the vendor.
Confirm the vendor can see the Terms and Conditions block.
Accept the required clause.
Leave the optional clause unaccepted.
